entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that performs measurement identity removal procedures as specified in the RRC protocol.

entities.name: Measurement Identity Removal Procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE removes measurement identities from its configuration based on the received measIdToRemoveList.

entities.name: measIdToRemoveList
entities.description: List of measurement identities that the UE should remove from its current configuration.

entities.name: measId
entities.description: Measurement identity that identifies a specific measurement configuration in the UE.

entities.name: VarMeasConfig
entities.description: UE variable storing the current measurement configuration.

entities.name: measIdList
entities.description: List of measurement identities within VarMeasConfig.

entities.name: VarMeasReportList
entities.description: UE variable storing measurement reporting entries.

entities.name: Timer T321
entities.description: Timer used for periodical measurement reporting.

entities.name: Timer T322
entities.description: Timer used for periodical measurement reporting.

entities.name: measId included in current UE configuration
entities.description: Condition that checks if a measurement identity is part of the current UE configuration in VarMeasConfig.

relations.description: The UE performs the measurement identity removal procedure.
The procedure uses the measIdToRemoveList information element.
The procedure is guarded by the condition that measId must be included in current UE configuration.
The procedure removes entries from the measIdList.
The procedure removes measurement reporting entries from VarMeasReportList.
The procedure stops timer T321 if running.
The procedure stops timer T322 if running.
